# Grounded by live API capture captures/20260611T133103Z-api_order_type_matrix_aapl.
# server_version=200, events.jsonl sha256 prefix: 4e0eb7d61bf5a743.
# Replays the order-type breadth matrix (ORD-001 type variants) observed on
# 2026-06-11 against live paper Gateway during US market hours. Real
# outcome per type (all values live):
#   379 MKT BUY        fills 40 @ 292.18 + 40 @ 292.20 + 20 @ 292.21 (avg
#                      292.194); flatten 380 fills 40 + 60 @ 292.17
#   381 LMT BUY 350.62 (marketable) price-band cancelled by the Gateway
#                      itself: PendingCancel -> Cancelled + code-202
#                      reject text, no fill
#   382 LMT BUY 14.61  rests Submitted, API cancel -> Cancelled + 202
#   383 STP BUY 350.62 PreSubmitted why_held=trigger (echo carries the
#                      computed limit 350.65), cancel -> Cancelled + 202
#   384 STP LMT 351.62/350.62 PreSubmitted trigger, cancel -> 202
#   385 TRAIL SELL     aux 1, trail stop 2921.8: first echo carries the
#                      computed limit 2921.8300000000004, then the trail
#                      triggers and fills 100 @ 291.82; the cancel races
#                      the fill -> 10148; flatten 386 fills 40 + 40 @
#                      291.97 + 20 @ 292.02
#   387 TRAIL LIMIT    offset 0.05, echo limit 2921.75, PreSubmitted
#                      trigger -> Submitted, cancel -> Cancelled + 202
#   388 MIT BUY 350.62 PreSubmitted (no why_held) -> Submitted -> fills
#                      100 @ 291.89; cancel races -> 10148; flatten 389
#                      fills 100 @ 291.75
#   390 LIT BUY 351.62/350.62 -> Submitted -> fills 40 @ 291.67 + 40 @
#                      291.71 + 20 @ 291.73 (avg 291.698); cancel races ->
#                      10148; flatten 391 fills 40 + 40 + 20 @ 291.67 (its
#                      first fill arrives while still PreSubmitted)
#   392 MTL BUY        PreSubmitted -> Submitted -> fills 40 + 60 @
#                      291.75; cancel races -> 10148; flatten 393 fills
#                      40 @ 291.70 + 60 @ 291.69
#   394 REL BUY 14.61  Gateway assigns offset 0.01, rests Submitted,
#                      cancel -> Cancelled + 202
#   395 LMT BUY 14.61  rests; Modify re-places as MKT, fills 40 @ 291.32
#                      + 60 @ 291.42 (avg 291.38); flatten 396 fills 40 @
#                      291.32 + 40 + 20 @ 291.28 (avg 291.296)
#   397 FEELINGS       rejected outright, code 321 invalid order type
#   398 MOC BUY        accepted silently (no echo at all); cancel ->
#                      PendingCancel -> Cancelled + 202
#   399 LOC BUY 350.62 accepted silently; cancel -> PendingCancel ->
#                      Cancelled + 202
#   400 MOO / 401 LOO  rejected outright, code 321 (the Gateway does not
#                      accept MOO/LOO type strings; MKT/LMT with tif=OPG
#                      is the supported form)
#   402 PEG MKT        rejected with code 387 "Unsupported order type for
#                      this exchange and security type."
#   403 PEG PRI        rejected outright, code 321
#   404 PEG MID        accepted silently; the cancel draws code 10342
#                      ("The 'ImbalanceOnly' order attribute may not be
#                      specified for this order."); the final global
#                      cancel surfaces Cancelled + 202 "Order was
#                      discarded." + a code 161
#   405 PEG BEST       same shape as PEG MID
#   406 PEG BENCH      accepted silently; the cancel is rejected with
#                      code 321 "Missing reference financial instrument"
# The final safety global cancel also re-answers the dead PEG MKT order
# 402 with Cancelled + 202 + 161; its handle already closed with the 387.
# The 404/405 code-161 replies remain session notices, and their just-delivered
# Cancelled statuses own both clean handle closes. Execution times use the UTC
# dash form; executions and commissions must reach the handles.
# Sanitized: account identifiers redacted to the DU9000001 redaction token,
# perm ids -> 900<order id>, order refs ->
# ibkrgo-sanitized-20260611T133103Z-001..-028, execution ids ->
# sanitized-matrix-001..-026. Trimmed: farm-status 2104/2107/2158, the
# driver's startup safety global cancel and its code-161 replies for the
# previous capture's orders, the driver's delayed-quote anchor exchange
# (market-data-type toggles, the req 1/2 tick stream, and the code-10089
# entitlement notice), and the driver's verification executions query (114
# updates; the api_order_fill transcript freezes the executions-query
# path).
